text:
Residents:
Felix and Aisha work weekdays 8:00-17:30. They leave the house around 09:00 and return around 18:00. Weekends: sleep in, errands midday, home rest of day. Both are home evenings.

Object Locations (Current State, Mon 23:59):
Balcony: gloves, watering can, spray bottle (table).
Bathroom: detergent, laundry basket, Felix razor, toiletry bag, Aisha/Felix skincare (shelf); Aisha razor, soap, toothbrushes (sink); Aisha meds, Felix skincare (cabinet); towels (rack).
Bedroom 1: ironing board (floor); Aisha laptop, Felix charger, Aisha/Felix headphones, Aisha notebook/pen (desk); Felix hair dryer (bed); Aisha/Felix books, tablets, Aisha glasses (bed); empty wardrobe.
Entry: toolbox, vacuum (floor); Aisha/Felix jackets, scarves, backpacks, Felix laptop, Aisha lunchbox (hook); Aisha/Felix keys, wallets (table); Aisha/Felix shoes (rack).
Kitchen: kettle, toaster, clock, cutting board, pan, spatula (counter); knives (drawer); duster, Aisha/Felix glasses, mugs, bowls, plates, snack bowl, serving dish (cupboard); Aisha/Felix water bottles (dish rack); fruit bowl (table); shopping bag (pantry).
Living: cushions, blanket (couch); board game, picture, speaker, vase (shelf); candle, coasters, tissues, remote (coffee table); lamp (side table).
Office: empty.

Movement Patterns:
- Morning routine (08:00-09:00): Residents prepare to leave. Items like phones, tablets, and water bottles move to kitchen table or sink. By 09:00, personal items (jackets, keys, wallets, shoes, bags, laptops, headphones, chargers, umbrellas) are "not in any room" (carried out) until 18:00 return.
- Evening return (18:00-19:00): Items reappear in entry (floor/hook/table). Aisha’s items often arrive slightly later (19:00) than Felix’s (18:00).
- Kitchen items (cutting board, knives, pan, spatula, plates, mugs, bowls) move between counter, sink, cupboard, and table during evening meal prep/cleanup (19:00-23:00).
- Water bottles (Aisha/Felix) appear in entry at 18:00, move to kitchen dish rack by 21:00.
- Aisha’s headphones move entry -> bed (21:00) -> desk (22:00).
- Aisha’s glasses move coffee table -> desk (00:00) -> nightstand (22:00).
- Felix’s charger moves nightstand -> desk (00:00) -> entry (18:00) -> not in any room (09:00).
- Phones (Aisha/Felix) appear at 18:00/19:00 (coffee table/nightstand), move to nightstand by 21:00, then often "not in any room" (carried) by 22:00-23:00.
- Remote moves TV stand -> coffee table -> couch (21:00-23:00).
- Blanket moves couch -> coffee table -> couch (21:00-23:00).
- Shared kitchen items (serving dish, snack bowl) move cupboard -> table -> cupboard (20:00-22:00).
- Felix’s book/tablet move nightstand -> bed (22:00).
- Shopping bag moves pantry -> out of house -> pantry (19:00-21:00).
- Weekend Errands: Felix leaves ~11:00, returns ~12:0
